subject.title: fix(release): detect missing bundled providers after npm install

question: Should this protected release-verification change proceed after the contributor supplies installed-package proof that the canonical artifact list excludes all intentionally non-bundled extensions?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the remaining question is whether the package contract represented by the verifier is the intended release boundary rather than merely a test fixture assumption.

options.title: Request installed-package proof
options.body: Require a packed npm artifact run that demonstrates failure for a removed required manifest and success for the complete artifact, including the intentionally excluded extension cases.

options.title: Accept the test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression tests and CI while accepting the residual risk that packaging exclusions were not demonstrated from an installed artifact.

recommendation.title: Request installed-package proof
recommendation.body: Require a packed npm artifact run that demonstrates failure for a removed required manifest and success for the complete artifact, including the intentionally excluded extension cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects this contributor to the release-verification implementation and regression fixtures.
